sections.title: First Mages Guild Visit
sections.objective: Open Mages Guild access as part of a useful Chorrol stop.
sections.preparation: Bring a little gold and leave space for alchemy or spellcasting supplies.

walkthroughBlocks.title: Pair guild access with your Chorrol errands
walkthroughBlocks.text: After selling and repairing in Chorrol, visit the Mages Guild before leaving town. Speak with a guild representative about joining, look over the services available to a new member, and take note of any local task without feeling obliged to finish it immediately. This makes the same hub visit cover shopping, travel planning, and magical support.

steps.text: Ask a Mages Guild representative about joining.
Review the guild services that support your current build.
